versions.changelog:
ai-news-website-generator v1.0.0

- Initial release of a full-stack AI news aggregation site generator
- One-click scaffold for Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend, and Dockerized deployment
- Supports aggregation and de-duplication of multiple configurable RSS feeds
- Includes autoscheduled feed refresh, filtering, infinite scroll, and responsive design
- Easily customizable and documented for project setup, deployment, and extension
